# PART 4 – Multiverse, inference and preregistration {#part-4-multiverse-inference-and-preregistration .darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 4 – 90 minutes
:::

::: notes
Last part. You spent the end of Part 3 trying specifications and watching the estimate move. Now we give that activity its proper name and read it as a chart of every justifiable analysis of this claim on these data, with the five analysts and the original result placed on it. Then a question that the paper could not answer for its readers, because it printed every standard error as nought point nought nought: how sure can a hundred thousand respondents make us, when they come from only sixteen countries? Then the two replications that SCORE ran on later rounds of the survey, and what none of the repetitions can settle. And then you settle on one analysis, preregister it before you run it, and submit it to the class chart.
:::
